fields.quoted_span: after a tenant has continuously and lawfully occupied a residential real property for 12 months, the owner of the residential real property shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in the written notice to terminate tenancy.
fields.note: The at-fault and no-fault causes, the cure notice, the relocation or rent waiver, the void-notice rule, the damages, the injunctions and the waiver rule all appear in the statute.

fields.note: The 12/24-month trigger, the 15-day payment, the 90-day and 12-month owner move-in terms, the 30-day remodel vacancy, the up-to-3x damages and the 2030 repeal are all in the text.

fields.quoted_span: (m) This section shall become operative on April 1, 2024.
